أقترف (form VIII)
# أَقْتَرِفُ (ʔaqtarifu) /ʔaq.ta.ri.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# أُقْتَرَفُ (ʔuqtarafu) /ʔuq.ta.ra.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# أَقْتَرِفَ (ʔaqtarifa) /ʔaq.ta.ri.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# أُقْتَرَفَ (ʔuqtarafa) /ʔuq.ta.ra
